segments.text: Number 16... During her first month as a volunteer at a local museum, Nina had trouble answering visitors' questions about an old bridge. She knew the basic facts, but she often forgot important dates during busy tours. Instead of memorizing a long guidebook, she made a small timeline and reviewed it before each shift. She can now explain the bridge's history more clearly.
